name: Bird of Paradise
description:
Michalina Janoszanka (1889–1952)

A bright-feathered bird grips a golden branch among dark-hearted blossoms, set against deep black.

Janoszanka, a Polish painter from Kraków, is best known for pictures like this one, painted in reverse on the back of a sheet of glass.

name: Butterfly
description:
Michalina Janoszanka (1889–1952)

A patterned butterfly drifts past a gilded tree at the water's edge, under a night-black sky threaded with fine white lines.

Painted in reverse on glass.

name: Spring
description:
Michalina Janoszanka (1889–1952)

A speckled frog sits among toadstools beside a dark pond of water lilies, beneath trees hung with blue blossom.

Painted in reverse on glass.

name: Winter
description:
Michalina Janoszanka (1889–1952)

Two ravens talk on a snow-covered branch in a forest of golden trunks and falling stars.

Painted in reverse on glass.

name: The Marvellous Tree
description:
Virginia Frances Sterrett (1900–1931)

Rosalie leans towards a twisting scarlet tree hung with grapes, plums and pears, in a walled garden under a starry sky.

From Old French Fairy Tales by the Comtesse de Ségur, 1920.

name: Bonne-Biche
description:
Virginia Frances Sterrett (1900–1931)

Blondine throws her arms around the neck of the white hind Bonne-Biche, while the cat Beau-Minon sits by a coral curtain.

From Old French Fairy Tales by the Comtesse de Ségur, 1920.

name: The Tortoise
description:
Virginia Frances Sterrett (1900–1931)

Blondine rides a great patterned tortoise through a forest of pale green trunks and trailing vines.

From Old French Fairy Tales by the Comtesse de Ségur, 1920.

name: The Giant
description:
Virginia Frances Sterrett (1900–1931)

Henry, in red, shields his eyes as a green giant peers down at him over a wall of white stone and blossom.

From Old French Fairy Tales by the Comtesse de Ségur, 1920.

name: The Plant of Life
description:
Virginia Frances Sterrett (1900–1931)

Henry stands in a mountain garden thick with flowers while an old doctor in a black cloak bends over the beds with his book.

From Old French Fairy Tales by the Comtesse de Ségur, 1920.

name: The Evening Walk
description:
Virginia Frances Sterrett (1900–1931)

Rosette, in a yellow gown, walks beside the prince before a pale palace of domes and spires under a sky full of stars.

From Old French Fairy Tales by the Comtesse de Ségur, 1920.

name: Night in the Forest
description:
Virginia Frances Sterrett (1900–1931)

Violette sleeps on the moss in her wide yellow dress while Ourson keeps watch beneath trees hung with lichen and a single bright star.

From Old French Fairy Tales by the Comtesse de Ségur, 1920.
